body:
Versions
--------
- 17.4+

Steps
-----
1. Ensure that Mitchell Admin has a child delivery partner in the database with the following information:
'name': 'Mitchell Admin',
'email': 'admin@yourcompany.example.com',
'street': '215 Vine St',
'country': 'US',
'city':'Scranton',
'zip':'18503'
2. Log in to eCommerce as Mitchell Admin
3. Add any deliverable product to the cart
4. Pay using Express Checkout

Issue
-----
Express Checkout fails when customers use different billing and shipping addresses. If the shipping address is unknown to the system, a validation error blocks payment. If known, the payment goes through but results in a generic shipping error with no further details or options for the user.

Cause
-----
`billing_address` was wrongly parsed as `shipping_address` in a5df1a7.

Solution
--------
Parse `shipping_address` correctly.

We replace timestamps in our golden files to keep the values constant.

However, if a non-UTC timezone is used then the timestamp will still be replaced but the whitespace will be messed up (since it was aligned to the original value).

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7ebf615-5b41-41bb-8939-682a45a61952)

Therefore we must force a timezone when generating golden files.

Find a solution, verify this change on launched machine work

```bash
sudo vim /etc/ssh/sshd_config

# Allow 150+ concurrent sessions
MaxSessions 200 

# Allow 150 unauthenticated connections, with gradual throttling
MaxStartups 150:30:200

sudo systemctl restart sshd
```

default value of `MaxSessions` is 10, default value of `MaxStartups` is 10:30:60

The config means if more than 10 sessions, between 10-60 sessions, will drop 30% connection. If above 60 sessions, will drop all.

Our test submits 150 jobs in parallel. Even with small time differences in SSH connections and commands, it's very likely to exceed the default 10

body:
- Move static metadata from `setup.py` to `pyproject.toml`. _Side note: I'd recommend to remove the corresponding attributes from `caio/version.py`. They can be accessed via `importlib.metadata` if necessary._
- Add SPDX license identifier for PEP 639 license expression support.
- Require Python `>=3.9`, i.e. drop support for `3.8`. Setuptools `v77` (necessary for PEP 639 support) is only available on Python 3.9+. _If that's a dealbreaker at the moment, it would be possible to use the legacy `project.license.text` field for it instead._
- Remove unnecessary entries from `MANIFEST.in` as well as `include_package_data (the default with `pyproject.toml` configs)  and `package_data` => The files included in the sdist / wheel stay the same.
- Remove duplicate project url with different key. One link to the repo should probably be enough.
- Updated `tox.ini`
  - `py.test` should be replaced with `pytest`
  - Remove `python setup.py checkdocs`. I believe it isn't supported anymore.
_https://github.com/jaraco/pytest-checkdocs/ might be alternative, though I'm not sure that's necessary here._

Metadata diff
```diff
 ...
-Author: Dmitry Orlov <me@mosquito.su>
-Author-email: me@mosquito.su
+Author-email: Dmitry Orlov <me@mosquito.su>
```

author: mildtomato
body:
- improving column visibility, order management, and state persistence. 
- Key changes include adding a new column visibility feature, refactoring state management for better clarity and extensibility, and updating the grid rendering logic to support dynamic column visibility and ordering.

This pull request introduces enhancements to the table grid editor, focusing on improving column visibility, reordering, and state management. The key changes include adding a new `ColumnVisibilityPopover` component, refactoring column reordering logic, and updating how grid state is loaded and synchronized with the URL.

### Column visibility and reordering enhancements:
* Added a new `ColumnVisibilityPopover` component to allow users to toggle column visibility and reorder columns via a drag-and-drop interface. This includes support for pinned columns and dynamic updates to the column order.

### State management improvements:
* Updated `useLoadTableEditorStateFromLocalStorageIntoUrl` to include `col_order` and `hidden_cols` in URL parameters, ensuring column order and visibility are restored from local storage. Added a mechanism to avoid unnecessary URL updates. 
* Refactored `Grid` component to use a memoized `processedColumns` array that filters and orders columns based on visibility and selection state.

### Column reordering refactor:
* Replaced the old column reordering logic in `ColumnHeader` with a new `useTableColumnOrder` hook, simplifying the synchronization of column indices and improving performance.

### Minor updates:
* Added `SELECT_COLUMN_KEY` to constants imports across multiple files to manage the selection column consistently.

# Update reakit to latest version of ariakit

[Asana](https://app.asana.com/1/203394141643832/project/1199153462262248/task/1208429647856303?focus=true)

## What

This PR updates ariakit (formerly reakit) to it's latest version. 

## Why

This fixes a bug where if you have multiple `menu` components (from ariakit) on a single page. If you were to open one, then scroll that open menu out of view and try to open another one, the first one would scroll back into view. 

It's also nice when packages are up to date.

### Sidenote

This PR adds the ariakit package and uses it it the `judicial-system` project and in a few places in island-ui. I decided not to update everywhere, due to the complexity that would entail. Rather, I'd like to make other teams responsible for updating their own code an let both packages live in the meantime.

author: schlenk
body:
This handles https://github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-python/issues/868 

If a license file is not decodeable as UTF-8, it uses the fallback to io2str using chardet to determine the encoding will be tried.

It also adds some tests to exercise the code:
- A UTF16 encoded file. chardet fails to detect it as UTF-16, so it gets skipped.
- A RTF file. This is technically text/rtf (or application/rtf, but misdetected as application/msword...). It is technically UTF-8 and gets properly encoded.
- A plain text UTF-8 file. This gets properly encoded (but maybe the XML encoding should have xml:space="preserve" set, to properly protect newlines).

author: chuck-dbos
body:
- Move remainder of serialization/deserialization responsibility out of System DB
- Move cancel logic into the system DB, where the cancel status is queried.
- Implement "preemptive cancel", whereby the system DB interrupts anything sleeping when it is cancelled. This will work for a cancel from the local node only.
- Formalize the notion that getResult is a call with a recorded output. Arguably, this was unnecessary originally, as getResult waited indefinitely for an immutable result. Now, cancel and resume of workflows means that the result is not immutable
- A few more extraneous UUID mentions removed
- Add polling to getEvent and recv, in case notifications are lost
- Solidify and centralize the callback logic a bit
